label: H.R. 10329
title: Combating Foreign Threats to Main Street Act of 2026
short_title: Combating Foreign Threats to Main Street Act of 2026

latest_action.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Small Business and Entrepreneurship.

summary: Combating Foreign Threats to Main Street Act of 2026 This bill requires the Small Business Administration to publish materials to educate small businesses about how they could be harmed by foreign adversary conduct such as cyber intrusions, fraud, intellectual property theft, or the use of forced labor. The educational materials must (1) describe the conduct that poses such harm, (2) identify best practices for small businesses to protect sensitive information and supply chains, and (3) provide guidance for cybersecurity and data protection.
summary_short: Requires the Small Business Administration to publish materials to educate small businesses about how they could be harmed by foreign adversary conduct such as cyber intrusions, fraud, intellectual property theft, or the use of forced labor.
